# Charlotta

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old (initially)  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Origin:** Boston (later moved back there)  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048)</sub>
- **Role:** handmaiden  <sub>[v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- **Titles:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Charlotta the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Charlotta the Fourth has a freckled face, a snubbed nose, and a fearfully wide mouth and smile. She originally wore very blue ribbon bows in her hair, but eventually grew into young ladyhood and discarded them in favor of an enormous pompadour.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Charlotta is cheerful, happy, and warm-hearted, possessing an immense devotion to her mistress. She admires Anne wholeheartedly and often practices imitating her manners in front of a mirror. She lacks patience with men, considers herself intended to be an old maid, and is obedient to Miss Lavendar's whims without complaining.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)_

## Traits

- cheerful  <sub>[v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022)</sub>
- warm-hearted  <sub>[v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043)</sub>
- admirous of Anne Shirley  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)</sub>

## Abilities

- domestic housework, gardening, and assisting with sewing  <sub>[v2 c27 P22](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0022), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- to love, serve, and protect her adored mistress, Miss Lavendar  <sub>[v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
- to learn to look, speak, and walk like Anne Shirley  <sub>[v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)</sub>

## History

Charlotta came to live at Echo Lodge to serve Miss Lavendar Lewis for board and clothes. She proved to be the best and most tolerant of the Bowman sisters regarding Miss Lavendar's imaginative pretenses. While working at Echo Lodge, she became fond of regular guests Anne Shirley and Diana Barry, warmly welcoming them whenever they visited. When Miss Lavendar fell into low spirits, Charlotta voiced her deep worries to Anne after accidentally breaking an heirloom bowl without receiving a scolding. Following Miss Lavendar's wedding, Charlotta moved with her and her new husband to Boston, where she felt terribly homesick. She later returned to Echo Lodge during summer vacations as a fully grown-up young lady.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P43](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0043), [v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- her real name is Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- she is the last and youngest of the Bowman sisters who worked for Miss Lavendar at Echo Lodge  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- her sisters before her were also called 'Charlotta' by Miss Lavendar to avoid confusion  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Quotes

> Miss Lavendar isn’t well, Miss Shirley, ma’am. I’m sure she isn’t, though she never complains.  <sub>[v2 c27 P44](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0044)</sub>

> Please, Miss Shirley, ma’am, it’s plain to be seen you and Miss Lavendar have got a secret and I think, begging your pardon if I’m too forward, Miss Shirley, ma’am, that it’s real mean not to tell me when we’ve all been such chums.  <sub>[v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048)</sub>

> Some women’s intended from the start to be old maids, and I’m afraid I’m one of them, Miss Shirley, ma’am, because I’ve awful little patience with the men.  <sub>[v2 c28 P55](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0055)</sub>
